title: Places he has been and wants to go, and closing
summary: He has been to South America, Canada, Europe and Africa but not the Far East; he would like to go to Japan. The proceedings end.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Now, you've been in Europe and Africa. How about the Far East?
I haven't ever been in the Far East. I've been to South America and Canada. I've been to Europe, been to Africa. I've never --
-- I haven't been to Australia or haven't been to -- I haven't been to the Orient or Honolulu. I've been all over the United States, but I look forward to
going to Japan. But the way things are changing now, the whole concept of the countries are changing too with it.
